product.title: Rome Food Tour: Hidden Gems of Trastevere with Dinner & Wine

description.text: Taste your way through Rome like locals do on this small-group food tour of the Trastevere neighborhood. Your guide will take you to four carefully selected eateries in the historic neighborhood where you can sample authentic Roman dishes, from street food and cured meats to baccalà and gelato. Stops include Piazza Farnese, Trastevere. You'll also sit down for a meal at a restaurant and drink wine and beer. Ideal for visitors basing in Rome who want a guided city experience without coordinating Metro routes, attraction tickets, or landmark timing on their own. Routes stay oriented to Piazza Farnese, Trastevere that define this Rome sightseeing experience, with a guide handling Metro connections, ticket windows, and neighborhood pacing so the day stays focused on the city rather than logistics.
